releaseIdentity.sourceOfCommitInReleaseCandidate: GITHUB_SHA after workflow assertion GITHUB_SHA == source_sha

physicalTest.purpose: temporary physical-device acceptance and reproducible engineering evidence

production.purpose: bounded support breadcrumbs attached only after explicit user action

sentry.purpose: technical crash and runtime error diagnosis

posthog.policy: A bounded HTTPS delivery adapter exists but remains disabled by default. Code permits activation only when SENTINEL_ENV=staging and exact release/source identity is supplied. Network egress is selected only from literal PostHog US/EU ingestion endpoints. Local/PostgreSQL operational telemetry remains canonical and provider delivery is fail-isolated. Production PostHog activation is not permitted by this contract.

quality.report.user.payloadPolicy: ticket text plus separately consented sanitized diagnostic snapshot

physical-test.forensic.payloadPolicy: larger app-private structured ring with local explicit export

retention.physicalTestApk: 90 days per exact-SHA GitHub Actions artifact
retention.physicalTestLocalForensics: bounded app-private ring; explicit local export; remove test app/data after acceptance
retention.userTicketDiagnostics: 30 days maximum in Core; payload is independently pruned while ticket metadata remains
retention.coreOperationalRecentTrace: bounded in-memory ring plus configured PostgreSQL retention seam
retention.externalSentry: provider/account retention is an Owner/external configuration gate; repository emits only minimized payloads
retention.posthog: staging-only provider/account retention is an Owner/external configuration gate; repository emits only the bounded operational allowlist when explicitly enabled

currentReleaseUnhandledFatal.condition: one or more unhandled fatal events on the currently evaluated release identity
currentReleaseUnhandledFatal.action: open/attach an engineering defect before promotion; preserve release/source correlation

repeatedSelectedRuntimeError.condition: same technical fingerprint repeats on one current release and materially affects a supported flow
repeatedSelectedRuntimeError.action: triage against exact release/source and reproduce before code change

ciRequiredCheckFailure.condition: any required exact-SHA check is failed, missing, stale or pending at merge gate
ciRequiredCheckFailure.action: diagnose and remediate in the same engineering loop; never substitute runtime telemetry for CI evidence

sequence: confirm event is privacy-safe and technically actionable
correlate with GitHub exact-SHA workflow/release evidence
link or create one GitHub/Linear defect with reproduction scope
implement regression evidence on a short-lived branch
require exact-HEAD CI and guarded merge
confirm fixed release identity before closing runtime regression

externalGates: Sentry project alert-rule provisioning and account retention settings
PostHog staging project credential/region/account-retention activation; production PostHog remains prohibited
